name: Dinosaur
label: Simple dinosaur
review: Original dinosaur prototype with exact hinge motion. Not a verified traditional origami tutorial.
descriptions: Fold the upper edge inward past the centre.
Fold the lower edge inward to match.
Bring the upper half down over the lower half.
Raise the left end of the body.
Tuck the tiny head point inward.
Turn the front leg tip upward.
Turn the back leg tip upward.
Open the front leg away from the body.
Open the back leg on the other side.
Ease the head crease open slightly.
Unroll the foot into a horizontal resting position.
Unroll the foot into a horizontal resting position.
